name: TDD Guard
description: Enforces test-driven development by requiring test file changes before implementation changes
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Enforce TDD: block implementation edits if no test was edited first
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
TDD_FLAG="/tmp/claude-tdd-test-written"
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(test|spec)\. ]]; then
  touch "$TDD_FLAG"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ ! -f "$TDD_FLAG" ]] && [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$ ]]; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Write a test first (TDD). Edit a .test. or .spec. file before implementation."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
